periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, angled approximately 45 degrees downward and outward from the sagittal plane.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a vertical axis approximately 1.7 times the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward extension where the mass of the patch is concentrated below the horizontal eye midline.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shape with a relatively flat posterior boundary across the dorsal midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Approximately 0.3 relative to the visible length of the torso from shoulder to tail base.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide inter-pinna gap, estimated at twice the width of an individual ear region.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Highly smooth, semi-circular convex curvature at the superior margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinct brownish-yellow discoloration of the fur on the abdominal and lower thoracic regions compared to the cranial white fur.
